_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: idx_trackers_live
data.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_trackers_live ON trackers (archived, sort_order) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

data.name: idx_tracker_entries_once_per_day
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_tracker_entries_once_per_day ON tracker_entries (tracker_id, local_date_key) WHERE once_per_day = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tag', "color" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4288585374, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "depth" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tag', "color" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4288585374, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "depth" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "usage_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_methods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "last4" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4288585374, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'card', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tz_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "payment_method_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id), "merchant" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "necessity" TEXT NULL, "satisfaction" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "capture_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_views" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "spec_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "chart_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "period_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'month', "period_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trackers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "per_tap_value" REAL NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "timer_started_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracker_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "tracker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trackers (id), "value" REAL NOT NULL, "occurred_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "tz_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "once_per_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("once_per_day" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_categories_path ON categories (path)
CREATE INDEX idx_tags_path ON tags (path)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_date ON transactions (local_date_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_category ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_unconfirmed ON transactions (is_confirmed, local_date_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_merchant ON transactions (merchant)
CREATE INDEX idx_txtags_tag ON transaction_tags (tag_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_saved_views_pinned ON saved_views (pinned, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_trackers_live ON trackers (archived, sort_order) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_tracker_entries_day ON tracker_entries (local_date_key, tracker_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tracker_entries_history ON tracker_entries (tracker_id, occurred_at_utc DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_tracker_entries_tracker_day ON tracker_entries (tracker_id, local_date_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_tracker_entries_once_per_day ON tracker_entries (tracker_id, local_date_key) WHERE once_per_day = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
